Players Committee card image of [[Captain Cassian Andor (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploys -1 if a Rebel leader on table. Once per game, may place a character in your Lost Pile out of play to cancel a just drawn weapon or battle destiny here. If just lost, may activate 1 Force. While at opponent's location immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/captaincassianandor.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13 eb9f1e8] (22 April 2024). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
